title: Ansel and the Machine
author: Paloma Dravenmoor
blurb: Casper Sterling, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
